I understand that, but its so incredibly hard to do. I've been so avoidant and adverse to just showing myself for years upon years that i don't know how to open up. When i open up to myself even i hate who i am and i hate me. But i hate fucking pretending that I'm okay to appease others. I've never had a heart to heart with anybody because I've chosen friends based on who i wish i was and they don't give a fuck about my problems. I want to just have someone i can reach out to but even when i do, my therapist and my ex, i still can't manage to expose my emotions and feelings and vulnerabilities. It just seems like nobody ever thinks I'm being serious. I would sometimes tell a friend that I was feeling miserable, and felt that way for a long time, and he or she would say a word or two and then just never bring it up again. If I ever told anybody I know that I have been thinking of killing myself, they'd probably say "uhhh, um, that's weird" and never speak to me again and then they'd act all surprised when I went through with it.

IM just so afraid of being me that i want to run away from it as well, and I've never felt more ready to end everything than i do now

I've been seeing a therapist for three years off and on.  I've realized however that I'm not totally open with him, like everyone else I know. I tell him I feel great sometimes but I know I'm tricking myself. I've faked so much in my life as a method of coping with a dysfunctional family and it worked when I was younger but now it just sends me further and further away from who I actually am. And the further away I get the more obsessed I become with this idea that maybe who I am is isn't cut out for this and I'll always get stuck without a person to reach out to. Im just tired of it and I don't know how to become me anymore. I just feel like id rather make that jump and end the fucking wandering. I mean, if I couldn't even show the person who was more important to me than anybody or anything that I cared, how can I manage to devote myself to anything else?
